raw_text: Deepfake video of IAF pilot goes viral ahead of elections; PIB flags it as fake. A manipulated video showing an Indian Air Force pilot purportedly making political statements has been flagged as a deepfake by the Press Information Bureau's fact-check unit. The video, which first surfaced on social media accounts linked to Pakistan, showed what appeared to be a serving IAF officer criticising the ruling government. PIB said the video bears all hallmarks of AI-generated content including facial inconsistencies and audio-visual mismatch. The Ministry of Defence has called it a deliberate attempt at election interference.
